stories.headline: Student Spotlight: Margot Ebel’s Outstanding Service at Aaron’s Place
stories.body: While many students find themselves exhausted after a jam-packed day of school, sports, and social life, Margot Ebel ’27, finds time every Thursday to volunteer at the local service organization, Aaron’s Place. Established in 2004, Aaron’s Place is a day program for children and adults living with developmental and physical disabilities. Ebel, who volunteers at the Greenlake branch, said, “The location I volunteer at is a house with only adults. There are two houses next to each other and the one I volunteer at has around eight residents and four teachers” A typical volunteer shift for Ebel includes playing cards, board games, reading books, solving puzzles, and drawing with residents and teachers.
